reading.zh: 从左到右：config 给阈值，flow 组装流式流程，optical-flow 算光流，ground-extent 估地面范围；箭头表示配置流向可通行性结果。
reading.en: Left to right: config supplies thresholds, flow assembles the streaming flow, optical-flow estimates the optical flow and ground-extent estimates the ground area; arrows run from configuration to the traversability result.
